scripts.dev: bun run build:web && bun run --filter @app/api dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter @app/web build && bun run --filter @app/api build
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun run --filter @app/api check && bun run --filter @app/web check
scripts.e2e: bun run db:migrate:local && bddgen && playwright test
scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler deploy -c apps/api/wrangler.toml --env=""
scripts.deploy:staging: bun run build && wrangler deploy -c apps/api/wrangler.toml --env staging
scripts.deploy:temp: bun run build && wrangler deploy -c apps/api/wrangler.toml --env="" --temporary
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply agentic-template-db --local -c apps/api/wrangler.toml
